input.text: Fictional Dubai outpatient applications, health declarations, structured eClaimLink-style claims, itemized bills, codes, plan rules, member history and provider statistics

work.text: Five sequential agents: enrollment; claim extraction; coding review; coverage adjudication; fraud/waste/abuse review, using JSON-schema tools in loops

output.text: Recorded eligibility, bill mismatches, coding findings, line pay/deny and denial codes, fraud signal scores and pay/review/hold recommendation

criteria.text: Best quality and reliable tool calling over cost; existing labelled Langfuse agent, claim and call-level evals; human approves every payment

constraints.text: UAE processing required for real health data; fictional test data permits non-UAE endpoints only as recorded residency gap; Cloudflare Workers AI and OpenRouter in use

assumptions: Use catalogued API models with JSON-schema tool support; non-UAE or unverified processing is a residency gap, not compliance.
Each agent has one model across its loop; no extra model needed for deterministic tools.

tasks.title: Enrollment
tasks.work: Extract declared chronic ICD-10-CM category prefixes and use tools to record eligibility.
tasks.output: Condition prefixes and recorded eligibility decision
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5 for medical category extraction; validate prefix accuracy and recorded eligibility against the enrollment fixtures.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.rationale: Leading medical coding and RCM evidence with agent workflow results.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.rationale: Strong clinical category and agent evidence.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.rationale: Strong healthcare workflows and repeated tool use.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.rationale: Strong balanced clinical and agent performance.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.rationale: Medical coding and sustained agent ability.

checks.metric: Chronic condition prefix precision/recall and schema-valid tool calls
checks.how: Use the two existing labelled enrollment fixtures and compare tool-call traces with their labels.
Run each candidate as an enrollment agent on the existing fixtures, comparing recorded decisions.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop if either fixture yields a wrong eligibility record or a rejected tool call.

tasks.title: Claims intake
tasks.work: Match bill lines to structured claim activities, total and record mismatches via tools.
tasks.input: Structured claim and free-text itemized bill
tasks.output: Matched lines, totals and recorded mismatches
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5 for revenue-cycle line reconciliation, but use the labelled claim runs to decide among the finalists.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.rationale: Top RCM evidence and competent multi-step business workflows.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.rationale: Strong RCM plus reliable enterprise workflow evidence.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.rationale: RCM, data analysis and agent strength.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.rationale: High RCM standing with enterprise tool-use evidence.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.rationale: Alternative provider with RCM and enterprise agent results.

checks.metric: Tool argument validity and result recorded
checks.how: Use Langfuse model-call traces to count rejected calls and missing records.

checks.metric: Bill-line match, mismatch and totals correctness
checks.how: Run candidates as experiments on the existing 14 labelled claims and compare bill mismatch labels.
Compare existing per-claim Langfuse labels with intake candidate substituted.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop after clear recurrent missed mismatches or rejected record calls compared with the leader.

tasks.title: Medical coding review
tasks.work: Use code lookup tools to find mismatches, unbundling and E/M upcoding and record findings.
tasks.input: Claim diagnoses, procedures and lookup results
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5 for code review; test E/M upcoding and unbundling specifically, since diagnosis-category benchmarks alone cannot validate CPT findings.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.rationale: Top ICD category and RCM evidence plus agent workflow evidence.

checks.metric: Valid code lookup and recorded findings
checks.how: Use existing Langfuse call traces for rejected lookup and record tool calls.

checks.metric: Coding findings precision/recall by error class
checks.how: Compare candidate experiments against existing coding finding labels on the 14 claims.
Compare existing per-claim claim-correct and payment-correct scores when substituting each candidate.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop if it consistently misses labelled upcoding or unbundling findings or fails to record them.

tasks.title: Coverage adjudication
tasks.work: Use plan-rule and amount-calculation tools to assign line pay/deny and denial codes.
tasks.input: Claim lines and retrieved plan rules
tasks.output: Recorded line decisions and denial codes
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5 for line adjudication; human payment approval lowers the autonomous-action risk but does not remove payment-error risk.

checks.how: Use existing per-call Langfuse traces to count rejected calls and unrecorded outcomes.

checks.metric: Correct pay/deny and denial code per line
checks.how: Use the existing 14 labelled claims' line-decision scores.
Compare existing claim-level payment-correct and review-load scores across candidate runs.
